shortBio.en: Rolling Stones frontman; lead vocal and lyric focus from the London R&B clubs onward.
shortBio.zh: Rolling Stones 主唱；从伦敦 R&B 俱乐部起负责主声线与歌词。

body.en:
Born 1943, Dartford. Co-founder of the Rolling Stones with Keith Richards. Lead vocals and much of the lyric writing across the catalog.

Stage pacing and harmonica parts sit beside the vocal on early records.
body.zh:
1943 年生于 Dartford。与 Keith Richards 共同创办 Rolling Stones。全目录主唱与大量作词。

早期唱片里舞台节奏与口琴和人声并行。
